visual_style.color_grading: Dark, cinematic, cool tones (blues, greens, grays)
visual_style.composition: Close-ups and medium shots to emphasize facial expressions and tension

subtitles.stroke_shadow: Black drop shadow and slight stroke for high contrast against dark backgrounds
subtitles.placement: Center, lower-middle of the screen, typical for short-form content
subtitles.animation: Dynamic, word-by-word appearance (karaoke style) to keep viewer retention

pacing_and_cuts.cuts: Frequent cuts between characters (shot-reverse-shot) to build dynamic tension

audio_video_sync.desync_details: The Russian dubbing does not perfectly match the original lip movements (English). It's a localized dub over the original English visual. The audio track itself is synced with the subtitle appearance, but lip flaps are out of sync with the Russian audio.
